Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.server.deck

Class TurnDeck<T>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.server.deck.Deck<T>
it.polimi.ingsw.model.server.deck.TurnDeck<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the objects contained inside the deck.
public class TurnDeck<T> extends Deck<T>
Represent resource and gold card decks. It's an extension of Deck which adds a variable number of objects that can be revealed without drawing them from the deck. The visible objects are considered separate from the main stack and calling isEmpty will only inform you of the status of the latter.
